symbols.name: set of reals
symbols.meaning: A nonempty set of real numbers whose supremum is taken.
symbols.quote: Let $\Sigma$ be a nonempty set of real numbers.

symbols.name: set element
symbols.meaning: An arbitrary element of the set $\Sigma$.
symbols.quote: Let $\chi$ denote an arbitrary element of $\Sigma$.

symbols.name: upper bound
symbols.meaning: A real number that is an upper bound of the set $\Sigma$.
symbols.quote: Let $\Omega$ denote a real number, and call $\Omega$ an *upper bound* of $\Sigma$ when $\chi \le \Omega$ for every element $\chi$ of $\Sigma$.
